name: com.submitbyhand/directory-submission
title: Submit by Hand
description: Startup, SaaS and AI tool directories to submit a product to, plus hand submission by our team.

tools.name: search_directories
tools.description: Search our checked list of live startup, SaaS, AI tool and general directories that accept product submissions. Free, no account needed. Each result has the submit URL, domain rating, pricing (free / freemium / paid), whether it needs an account, email confirmation, a captcha or a backlink, when we last checked it, and a step-by-step guide link where we have one. Highest domain rating first.

category.description: Only directories that list this kind of product. "general" = any product.

free_only.description: Only directories with a free way to submit (pricing free or freemium).

no_account.description: Only directories that need no account.

query.description: Part of the directory name or domain.

tools.name: get_directory
tools.description: Everything we know about submitting to one directory: requirements, the form fields it asks for, review time, link type (dofollow / nofollow), paid options, common rejection reasons and tips. Free.

tools.name: draft_listing
tools.description: Read a product's website and draft the listing copy directories ask for (name, tagline, short and long descriptions, categories, tags, features, use cases), then count how many directories in our list fit the product. Also returns each plan next to what the same directories take by hand (accounts to create, email confirmations, captchas, estimated hours), so the user can compare. Free; takes 10-30 seconds. The returned preview_id can be passed to create_order.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Plans for having our team submit the product to directories by hand: price, number of directories, delivery window, what is included, refund terms, and what the same directories take when done by hand. One-time payment, no subscription.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Open an order and get a Stripe checkout link for the user to pay. Call it only after the user has chosen a plan, agreed to buy, and given the email address for the order (the order link and receipt go there). Nothing is charged by this call: the user opens checkout_url and pays on Stripe. Pass preview_id from draft_listing, or product_url to draft the listing in the same call.

product_url.description: The product website, when there is no preview_id.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Progress of an order: paid or not, how many submissions are done, in review, live or declined, the delivery date, and the next step for the user. Takes the order_url from create_order (also emailed to the buyer).
